description: This file defines the XPdfForm class, which represents a 'PDF form external object' used for importing and displaying pages from external PDF documents within a PDFsharp-based .NET application. It includes constructors for loading PDF documents from file paths and streams, properties for accessing PDF page dimensions and properties, methods for instantiation, and internal management of the imported PDF document.

classes.name: XPdfForm
classes.description: Represents an external PDF form object used for importing and rendering pages from external PDF documents within PDFsharp.

methods.name: FromFile
methods.description: Creates an XPdfForm instance from a specified file path.

methods.name: FromStream
methods.description: Creates an XPdfForm instance from a given stream containing PDF data.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Marks the form as finished, potentially performing finalization tasks.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases resources and detaches the external PDF document.
